description.value: Fondue Stube is a cozy European-themed fondue restaurant located in the Studio Building of Sun Peaks Lodge, operating during the winter ski season only. It specializes in classic Swiss cheese, Canadian meat, seafood, and chocolate fondues paired with BC and international wines. Touring cyclists visiting Sun Peaks in summer will find this restaurant closed, but the Lodge itself offers bike rental and a full suite of warm-season mountain activities.

address.value: 3185 Creekside Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real fondue restaurant operating within Sun Peaks Lodge, open for winter season only; the page explicitly states 'Currently closed. We will re-open in December,' consistent with the current date of May 2026.
